newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Five soldiers die in clash with Colombian rebels.
newsitem.headline: Five soldiers die in clash with Colombian rebels.

text.p: At least five soldiers died and seven others were wounded in a clash with leftist guerrillas in western Colombia on Sunday, military sources said.
Suspected Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC) rebels ambushed an army patrol before dawn near the mountain town of Gaitania, in Tolima province, an army spokesman said.
The fighting lasted for about five hours. There were no reports of guerrilla casualties.
